verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware security key that runs entirely on the user's own device, with no cloud or hosted service component. The passkey "stays on your key. Not their cloud." and "No software or drivers required.", so there is no service to self-host, and the self-hosting axis is a category error for this product type. Evidence about building and flashing your own firmware on the Hacker key belongs to a separate firmware-openness story and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
